events.title: Sails of Salt is in Steam Next Fest – play the free demo
events.summary: Ahoy! Sails of Salt is part of Steam Next Fest from October 19 to 26, and the demo is free to play right now.Black Flag’s ship battles as an FTL-style rogueliteYou helm your own ship through real-time broadside battles, keep your crew alive and sail further out for richer prizes while the Empire hunts you. events.title: Demo Update 0.1.22
events.summary: NewKraken, reworked: His arms writhe, rise all around your ship, crash onto the deck or wrap around your hull and hold it fast while the others strike.When an arm has you in its grip, hold E to cut it loose – or burn it loose if you have fire shot aboard.Fleet in reach: Your fleet’s holds, provisions and crew only count for ships near you. Shipyard, tavern and Dock only work on those, and contract cargo is only handed over once its ship is there.A fleet ship out of reach eats from her own hold.

events.title: Demo Update 0.1.16
events.summary: NewNew ship, the fluyt: a slow trader with the biggest hold and spare berths. She sails the outer trade routes and leads every treasure fleet.Fleet: fittings and crew traits now work on your fleet ships too.Your flag: when you create your captain, pick a sign for the black flag that every ship in your fleet flies.Anything that can see you right now has an eye on its marker – ships, guns and harbours. events.summary: NewMore tooltips: hull figures, the chart, Rest and greyed-out purchases now explain themselves.You choose fleet orders with an icon button.Loading screen: no hint repeats before all have been shown; the compass card swings more calmly.The hint for going ashore now appears at the Caldera already.ChangedEnemy ships fire on you sooner.Finished buildings throw up sand and dust.Fewer stutters when ships or buildings appear.The water along your hull is quieter.FixedRumours: if you let one go or fail

events.title: Demo Update 0.1.12
events.summary: NewRepairs, reworked: shipyards and your dock can repair your ship all the way, in 25 % steps per click, at an increasing price. Your carpenter repairs up to 75 % at sea, up to 50 % in combat with Under Fire, and to full at landfall.Salvage, reworked: every shipwreck offers three finds to choose from: blueprints first, then colours, decorations or gold.
